name: azerbaijani-whisper-small
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-small (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of openai/whisper-small for Azerbaijani ASR. Same 242M parameters and 12-layer encoder-decoder as the base. Recorded because the card prints a 'whisper-small (baseline)' row and this row in one FLEURS-az table (921 samples, shared lowercase/no-punctuation normalization), and WER/CER are lower-is-better. Licence apache-2.0.

benchmarks.name: FLEURS Azerbaijani test WER
benchmarks.config: Card 'Performance' table, 'whisper-small (baseline)' 52.17% vs 'azerbaijani-whisper-small' 20.54%. FLEURS az test, 921 samples, lowercase/no-punctuation normalization, same for both rows. Lower is better. Card also lists whisper-medium 34.54 and whisper-large-v3 21.00 in the same table, so this 242M model also beats the 1.5B base-size ceiling.

benchmarks.name: FLEURS Azerbaijani test CER
benchmarks.config: Same table, base 14.52%. Lower is better. CER (5.72) is marginally worse than whisper-large-v3 (5.51) while WER is better - the CER win is only against whisper-small.
